course_summary:
ISEN 645 | Lean Engineering | Fall 2026
Instructor: Michael Graul, PhD PE | mgraul@tamu.edu
Meets: M 5:45PM-8:15PM | ZACH 445
Grading: Quizzes [15%], Homework [15%], Midterm exam [35%], Project Work [35%] — A: [90,100] B: [80-90) C: [70,80) D: [60,70) F: [0,60)
Topics: DFSS, IDEF0, IDEF3, SMED, 5S, EPE, Kanban, CONWIP, 3EQN/4GRA, DMAIC, SIPOC, C/E chaining, Gauge R&R, SPC, Gemba Kaizen, Kata, Beer game, 6σ, lean thinking, lean manufacturing cell design, systems engineering, factory physics principles, lean production system design principles, 8-Step design process, Operations Science, equation of lean, Buffer engineering (time, capacity, inventory), Lean supply chain P&P, SC definition and design, Integration with the PS via inventory, VOC visually aligned, instrumenting the PS, Characterizing Value, Value represented in the PS, VOC→VOE→VOP, Engineering the Value Stream, process engineering, Cell design, resource requirements estimation, Line balancing, Task engineering, WM&M, Controlling the Flow, Level loading, MM sequencing, int IC & PC, PS engineering for variability, flow imbalances, management, Implementation, Action planning, Leadership, Culture, Recitation, Application, Enriched Repetition, manufacturing systems, production systems, complex nature, interdependencies, knowledge, skills, experiences (KSEs), semester project, experiential component, state of the practice readings, classroom exercises, management tools, homework, skills dimension, value, value stream, flow, control, perfection, LPS maintenance, decay, single-piece flow, quantity control, quality control, LPS design, waste accounting, PS 'health' monitoring, variability reduction, SE architectures, practices, techniques, productive organization, lean-6σ culture, Lean systems, Lean Manufacturing, material flow, team-based project, production system design, operation, Core principles, definitions, philosophical requirements, managerial requirements, organizational requirements, quantitative modeling methodologies, case study analysis
Tools: Canvas, AI technology, AI-bot, AIChatbot
Prerequisites: ISEN 609 or approval of instructor
